meta.name: GCC Atlas demo data
meta.banner: Demo data compiled from public sources as of 28 Oct 2026. Records marked 'pending' have not yet been opened and confirmed by the author.

confidence_rule.High: The company's own page or press release states the centre's existence, city and function.
confidence_rule.Medium: A credible press report, or company job listings that show roles in the city without stating a dedicated centre.
confidence_rule.Low: A single secondary source or anything not yet opened.

notes: Headcount is null everywhere unless a source states a figure; wording is kept in headcount_note.
parent_hq_country and sector are editorial labels, not taken from the cited source.
City values are standardised: Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Delhi NCR, Mumbai.
Microsoft appears twice (Hyderabad and NCR) and shares group_id 'microsoft'.
Rents and per-city GCC counts are mostly unavailable; the Advisor must say so rather than estimate.
Registry is skewed to Hyderabad and Bengaluru; Mumbai has no verified records yet.
